title: Resignation Of Congress Ministries
definition: The collective resignation of Congress ministries in October-November 1939 across eight provinces as a protest against the British government's unilateral decision to involve India in World War II without consulting the Indian people.
importanceInUpsc: This event marks a critical shift from 'Constitutional Agitation' to 'Mass Struggle' (Individual Satyagraha and Quit India Movement), testing the candidate's understanding of the transition in Gandhian strategy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Resignation Of Congress Ministries.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
